core_obligations: Identify the two extreme cohomology groups: use the Hodge-to-de Rham spectral sequence, the vanishing of the differential sheaves above degree $d$, the vanishing of coherent cohomology above the dimension and the degeneration of the bottom and top parts to get $H^0_{dR}(X/k) = H^0(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ and $H^d(X, \Omega^d_{X/k}) = H^{2d}_{dR}(X/k)$, and choose the trace map $t$ through the Hodge duality lemma so that the pairing is perfect for $i = 0$ (proof lines 4708-4726).

Construct the pairings: the wedge map on $\operatorname{Tot}(\Omega^\bullet \otimes_{\underline{k}} \Omega^\bullet)$ annihilates the indicated subcomplex for degree reasons, hence factors through maps $\gamma_p$ from $\operatorname{Tot}(\sigma_{\leq p}\Omega^\bullet \otimes \sigma_{\geq d-p}\Omega^\bullet)$ to $\Omega^\bullet$, and induces cup products between $H^i(X, \sigma_{\leq p}\Omega^\bullet)$ and $H^{2d-i}(X, \sigma_{\geq d-p}\Omega^\bullet)$ (proof lines 4728-4759).
Set up the induction on $p$: the case $p = d$ is the assertion of the proposition and the base case $p = 0$ is the Hodge duality lemma (proof lines 4760-4768).

Perform the induction step using the two distinguished triangles expressing $\sigma_{\leq p+1}$ in terms of $\sigma_{\leq p}$ and $\sigma_{\geq d-p-1}$ in terms of $\sigma_{\geq d-p}$, and apply the 5-lemma once the four pairs of maps $(a,a')$, $(b,b')$, $(c,c')$, $(d,d')$ between the rows of the long exact sequences are shown compatible with the pairings (proof lines 4770-4819).

Verify the compatibility through the three commutative diagrams: the pair $(c,c')$ by functoriality of the cup product with $\gamma_p$ and $\gamma_{p+1}$, the pair $(b,b')$ by the same argument for the wedge on the degree $p+1$ part, and the pairs $(d,d')$ and $(a,a')$ by the remaining square and a shift of $i$ (proof lines 4821-4874).
Record that the uniqueness of $t$ up to precomposition with multiplication by a unit of $H^0(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ is left to the reader (proof lines 4876-4878).
proof_roadmap: Extreme degrees and the choice of the trace map (proof lines 4708-4726).
The restricted wedge maps and the induced cup products (proof lines 4728-4759).
Induction statement, base case and top case (proof lines 4760-4768).

Compatibility of the four pairs of maps through the commutative diagrams (proof lines 4821-4874).
Uniqueness left to the reader (proof lines 4876-4878).
difficulty_reason: The proposition is Poincare duality for the de Rham cohomology of a nonempty smooth proper equidimensional scheme over a field: there is a trace map on the top de Rham group, unique up to a unit of the structure sheaf's global sections, making the cup product pairing in complementary degrees perfect (statement lines 4689-4705). The proof first pins the extreme degrees and the correct trace map through the Hodge-to-de Rham degeneration data, then builds the pairings from restrictions of the wedge product on the total complex of the de Rham complex with itself, and proves them perfect by an induction on the truncation parameter whose step combines two distinguished triangles, their long exact sequences, a five-lemma argument and three compatibility diagrams for the cup products; the uniqueness statement is left to the reader. The two-sided induction with the five-lemma is the substance, so the claim is H3.
